relevance_note: Single-patient case report of a boy diagnosed with Alexander disease: "We report a male, four-year-old patient" and "Genetic testing was consistent with Alexander disease."
method_note: Built by hand from reading the paper; a short script only assembled the JSON and checked spans. One in-scope person (the single unnamed patient, label 'patient'). No variants table rows: the paper says only 'Genetic testing was consistent with Alexander disease.' and never ties a GFAP variant (or names the gene) for this patient, so no variant row was created; flagged for review. Publication year is not printed in the document, so year is null. n_patients_reported left null because the paper does not state a number of patients with a GFAP variant (one patient is described). Abstract says megalencephaly 'since birth'; Introduction says 'since the infantile period' (wording difference, recorded 'since birth' as onset of that feature). Age at symptom onset of the disease is not stated as such (first seizures at 2 years; megalencephaly since birth), so age_at_onset is 'not reported'. Motor milestone ages (sat with support at 9 months, unsupported 11 months, walked 18 months) are stated but not called delayed; not recorded as features. 'Extensive neurometabolic investigations ... were non-diagnostic' is a normal investigation as a whole and excludes nothing specific. 'no orolingual involvement or bulbar dysfunction' recorded as excluded features but not used to exclude the narrower checklist items dysphagia or dysarthria. Vital status left 'not reported' (not explicitly stated). Authors' affiliation (Istanbul, Turkey) is not the patient's origin; ethnicity left 'not reported'. No contradictions found.
